# scaling_routing_policy (Data Source)

Looks up a routing policy by name and exposes its id, so an inbound integration selector can reference a policy created out-of-band without hardcoding the generated id.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Reference a routing policy created out-of-band by name, for use in an inbound
# integration selector's routing_policy_id.
data "scaling_routing_policy" "default" {
  name = "Default"
}

output "default_routing_policy_id" {
  value = data.scaling_routing_policy.default.id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Name of the routing policy to look up. Must be unique within the organization.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) ISO 8601 creation timestamp.
- `description` (String) Human-readable description, or null if unset.
- `id` (String) Unique identifier of the matched routing policy.
- `is_default` (Boolean) Whether this is the organization's default routing policy.
- `org_id` (String) Organization that owns the policy.
- `updated_at` (String) ISO 8601 last-update timestamp.
